decisions.statement: The upstream file is loaded as a chunk with a line appended to hand its data out.
A table whose keys count up from the first index is written as an array.
This module keeps its own serializer rather than the shared serializer.
A run leaving the data table empty is refused rather than written.
The ported file names the upstream version the data came out of.
The file written is named to the caller as soon as that file is written.

definition: the treasure pins upstream LibTreasure carries, copied out as TypeScript
